Job Description

As a Security Officer Full Time Badge System Support in Richardson, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Commercial Real Estate, and more. Join Allied Universal as a Security Officer supporting a commercial real estate location. You will monitor and patrol assigned areas, maintain a visible presence to help deter security-related incidents, manage access control activities, and provide outstanding customer service and communication.
